key_points: AAPL fell sharply, with reports of a near-10% slide and Wall Street citing ongoing AI supply-chain headwinds.
Tim Cook reportedly confirmed Apple product price increases due to a memory chip crunch, suggesting near-term margin pressure.
Analyst commentary questions whether iPhone Duo volume is sufficient to offset broader concerns, implying limited near-term upside catalyst.
Some institutional and retail flows are mixed, with buy ratings and accumulation reported alongside selling, but sentiment remains risk-off.
October 13 event risk and continued AI-related execution concerns could keep the stock volatile in the coming days.
